findings.detail: PP03 rows are comparative-period investment schedule rows retained in the 2025-12-31 holdings extract; AP Adhesives appears in the later comparative schedule block with values distinct from the December block.

rationale: The raw filing explicitly contains consolidated schedules of investments for both December 31, 2025 and September 30, 2025. A flagged issuer, AP Adhesives Holdings, appears in the current December block at table 10 rows 48-50 and again in the later comparative block at table 32 rows 45-47; the comparative row carries different period values such as interest rate 8.80% and amortized cost/fair value 1,659/1,667, while the December row carries 8.66% and 1,655/1,662. Retaining those earlier-period schedule rows in the report-date holdings extract is a real comparative-period leakage defect, not a false alarm.
